analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 41.1 to 52.7, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -2.1568 to 0.4525, signaling bottoming. Five consecutive daily closes form a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 24.2 indicates early trend formation, but -DI remains above +DI, suggesting direction is not yet firmly established.
